about: Strict track (2.77, live/strict.py): the pass test copied from Tanu (ADR-0005). An alert type + bench style passes only when its learn part (first 80% of the days) has at least min_trades trades, an average R above 0 and t at or above the multiple-testing bar (Bonferroni, 5% two-sided, over every setup with enough trades), its holdout (last 20% of the days) has at least min_hold trades with an average R above 0, and it beats the yardstick in both parts. The yardstick is coin-flip signals (a random symbol and direction every coin_every_min minutes of market time, traded on the test bench only, never an alert or a paper trade). A broken value falls back to the default.
